comment: Seventeen rows cover aggregate reads, replacements, literal capacity, output checks,
path lookup, caller replay, published writes and sources, reference classification,
bounded work for a copied direct aggregate call argument, and the empty loaded caller
The stage compiles and runs the same test with the mutant.
Run this table in the Linux VM with the debug preset.
build: mkdir -p build/Linux/debug/mutate && build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std -I src/fort -I test/fort/support -S -o build/Linux/debug/mutate/ownership_summary_direct_aggregate_test.ll test/fort/ownership_summary_direct_aggregate_test.ft

stages.name: direct aggregate summary module test
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --cc /usr/bin/clang --target x86_64-linux-gnu --verify-ir -j 1 ownership_summary_direct_aggregate

mutations.old: if (!aggregate_argument_reads(in, out, stmt, argument, block, gap)) { return; }
mutations.new: if (false && !aggregate_argument_reads(in, out, stmt, argument, block, gap)) { return; }
mutations.what: a copied aggregate omits each borrowed-leaf read
a constant reference leaf has no replacement before its call read

mutations.old: bool on_path = before && aggregate_path_block(out, block, at.block);
mutations.what: a leaf lookup can select a replacement from a sibling block
a caller rejects a nonempty projected replacement
a published string leaf omits its live static source fact
a void pointer leaf is not classified as a reference replacement
a caller treats a projected null or zero assignment as an allocation release
aggregate type traversal runs without W charges

mutations.new:
if (false && active && store &&
            applied->normal_continuation &&
            !refresh_private_leaves(c, s, &applied->state, node.effect.place,
mutations.what: a proved callee write leaves a copied aggregate read on its stale private leaf
a summary omits the canonical leaf write that follows a callee refresh
an unconditional store cannot replace joined old private contents
the parent walk treats numeric block order as execution order
a static-source lookup scans source rows without W charges
a struct literal reserves no slot for its field effects
a caller checks an old output leaf again after an earlier field of its literal
a caller refuses a move of an empty loaded owner as a null dereference
a caller accepts a dereference of an empty loaded owner
